description: Reproduce the failure, add a regression test, then patch the endpoint.

events.title: Task received
events.detail: A POST /users endpoint responds with 500 for missing email input. Expected: 400.

events.title: Inspect existing test suite
events.detail: The suite covers successful user creation but not invalid requests.

events.title: Create regression test
events.detail: Added a test asserting a 400 response when email is missing.

events.title: Confirm the failure
events.detail: The new test fails: expected 400, received 500. This reproduces the bug.

events.title: Inspect route handler
events.detail: Identified an unchecked email access in the request handler.

events.title: Implement validation
events.detail: Added explicit input validation and a 400 response for invalid requests.

events.title: Run test suite
events.detail: All tests pass, including the new regression test.

events.title: Validated patch
events.detail: The expected behavior is restored, with regression coverage for future changes.

evaluation.notes: Illustrative values only — not independently measured.
